verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents a `prefetch=True` mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and it offers BFS deep crawling with page limits. Together these show a first-party, lighter-weight way to find URLs. However, the evidence never shows site-wide enumeration of every URL without crawling pages, for example via sitemap or URL seeding. missing for 10: evidence of whole-site URL enumeration without page crawling (sitemap/Common Crawl seeding), documentation of how prefetch skips full processing, hands-on corroboration of 'instant' speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it

citations.quote: New `prefetch=True` mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery.
